title: ASL Hand Viewer
description: An interactive 3D hand visualization tool for exploring American Sign Language hand positions using three.js.
subject: Mathematics
author: Dan McCreary
learningObjectives: Identify the finger positions that distinguish ASL handshapes A, B, C, and 'I Love You' using the preset poses
Manipulate individual finger curl sliders to reconstruct a target ASL handshape from an open hand
Describe the hierarchical joint structure of the hand (palm, metacarpal, proximal, middle, distal segments) using the joint marker overlay
Compare right-hand and left-hand versions of the same handshape using mirror mode
Examine a handshape from multiple viewpoints by rotating, panning, and zooming the 3D camera
